ci.observed_failure: Expected changed model content to invalidate the verified receipt, but the verification or check_current returned success.

source_analysis.scope: open_checked denies concurrent writers while each temporary handle is open; snapshot and per-asset handles are closed before later cache use.

local_probe.fixture: 100 newly created isolated 4-byte files were overwritten in place with different 4-byte synthetic contents. Each probe inspected identity using native Windows APIs.

limitations: The two 100-run trials are separate and cannot be combined as one trial.
A local observation on one machine and filesystem, not a failure-rate claim across Windows or filesystems.
Probe uses native identity APIs but is not a rerun of the failed candidate source tests.
The results show an identity-based cache invalidation risk; they do not establish that any user's model has been corrupted.
No production source was changed, no hardware/driver claim was made, and no private content was used.
